description: The tool-identification trap the 3.5 work surfaced: a SHELL running the tmux-rc daemon whose LOG lines mention gemini-3.1-flash-lite and a Vertex generateContent URL. The foreground process is a shell running the server — it is NOT the Gemini CLI, and the gemini/claude names in the log content must NOT flip the tool. The load-bearing assertion is tool=shell. Streaming server output with no bare prompt returned → running. Real tmux-rc daemon log pattern.
